verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own portfolio-level construct: initiatives with lead teams, proposed and canceled statuses, and priority, framed around how work contributes to the broader direction. It also mentions strategic roadmaps and subscribable project views. None of this evidence shows initiatives aggregating multiple projects or computing rolled-up progress in one view. The custom-dashboards item is a third-party integration and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that initiatives or views group multiple projects, aggregated progress metrics across projects, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
